verdict.first_step_1: Run netstat -ano | findstr :8080, check the PID with tasklist, kill it with taskkill /F, then restart npm run dev.
verdict.first_step_2: Run netstat -ano | findstr :8080, identify the PID with Get-Process, kill it with Stop-Process -Force, and watch for accumulating node.exe processes.
